title: Security governance and accountability
description: Document security ownership, decision authority, escalation paths, and review responsibilities.

title: Cybersecurity risk assessment
description: Maintain a risk register with an owner, likelihood, impact, treatment, and review status.

title: Asset and telemetry source inventory
description: Maintain an inventory of monitored hosts, network assets, cloud accounts, and log sources.

title: Privileged access management
description: Restrict administrative access using least privilege, unique accounts, and MFA where supported.

title: Centralized logging and retention
description: Verify that security logs are collected, time-synchronized, protected, and retained according to policy.

title: Detection rule validation
description: Test important Wazuh rules, document expected results, and review false-positive rates.

title: Incident response procedure
description: Maintain incident severity criteria, analyst handoffs, escalation procedures, and response playbooks.

title: Human oversight of AI recommendations
description: Require an authorized analyst to validate AI-generated classifications and approve consequential response actions.

title: AI output traceability and evaluation
description: Record model identity, assessment references, supporting evidence, limitations, and evaluation outcomes.

title: Security data handling
description: Apply data minimization, access restrictions, retention rules, and safe handling for logs and incident evidence.

title: Backup and recovery readiness
description: Verify backups and periodically test recovery of critical SOC configurations, databases, and audit records.
